decisions.summary: Add a local-only reactive channel fixture gate that normalizes pushed CI and pull request review payloads into safe manual Athanor action recommendations without registering listeners.

expected_metrics.target: pass for committed local fake event fixtures
at least 9.5/10 after pushed CI/review event fixtures are CI-visible

verification_commands.expected: status pass with auto_listeners 0, auto_execute_actions 0, and irreversible_actions 0

observed_results.summary: P24 adds local fake CI/review event fixtures, a read-only mapper, schema, docs, CI gate, and explicit listener/auto-execution safety metadata.

decisions.rollback_or_follow_up: Rollback by removing the CI step and mapper if event normalization proves misleading; follow up with an opt-in authenticated listener only after a separate threat model.
